presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No blush, just the face and its expression.
presets.description: Blush shows up on half the avatars by default. Off, the two things left are the shape of the head and what it is doing with its eyes and mouth.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Brown face, brown ground, brown ink.
presets.description: Two mouth variants are excluded here. They are drawn with a pink tongue painted straight into the artwork, and no color option reaches it.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue at all, same mouth exclusion.
presets.description: The style is built on flat shapes with a soft drop shadow, so it survives losing color better than a line style would.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One mint face on one deep green.
presets.description: A single face color across a whole set. What is left to tell avatars apart is the head shape and the expression, which in this style is plenty.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty faces on a dusty ground.
presets.description: The style ships twelve faces at candy brightness. These twelve are the same idea in tones that hold still, for a list where a dozen appear at once. The tongue mouths are excluded, the same ones the monochrome presets drop, because their pink is painted in rather than picked.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Faces past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same lever the other way. The ground stays near-black so the face is the only lit thing on the tile.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Soft ground instead of the deep one.
presets.description: Every background the style ships is dark and saturated. These are pale, which turns the same avatar from a spotlight into a sticker.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: Louder than the shipped set and pushed toward the primaries. The dark ink around the eyes keeps the face readable on top of it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The face palette stays light rather than inverting, because a dark face loses its eyes and its drop shadow at the same time.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the face.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: The face scaled up in the frame.
presets.description: The style leaves a generous margin, which costs size at 24 or 32 pixels. This crops in until the face nearly touches the edge and the expression carries.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
